title: [epic] Filesystem block store backend
description:
## Why
A plain-directory block store (one file per CID, named by CID hex) is the simplest possible backend — no dependencies, human-inspectable, easy to rsync or backup. Primarily useful for debugging, cold import, and small offline deployments.

## Scope
- `[backend] type = "filesystem"` config with `path` directory
- `FsStore: IpfsStore` and `FsBlockStore: IpfsBlockStore` — files named `<cid-base32>.block` under the configured directory
- Startup: create directory if absent, verify writable
- Integration tests; RUNBOOK section
